title: Nikki's Music and chantments
description: a enchantment addon with a couple of custom music discs
body:
This datapack adds extra enchantments to the game with an addition of music discs of custom songs
### the current music list being 
- Rain by Kaz
- Tall by Naps The Block Music
- Tall Remastered by Naps The Block Music
- Ice by ThatMusicalSparrow
- Minecraft Fan-made Music by Adam Haynes
- Dog by C418
### the current enchantments list being
- Divinity - Totem
- Exploding - Mace
- Iron Core - Chestplate
- Lava Walker - Boots
- Lightness - Helmet
- Shrinking - Helmet
### What each enchantmet does
- Divinity: Gives a stronger totem effect
- Exploding: like windcharging but more explosive
- Iron Core: gives 2 extra hearts depending on its level up to 10
- Lava walker: turns lava into magma
- Lightness: makes the player take less fall damage and has their gravity reduced
- Shrinking: shrinks the player and removes 2 hearts based on their enchant level up to 5
